Second-adapter ligation and PCR on purified cDNA are explicit catalogue actions. Figure 1A independently confirms a second-cDNA-adapter concept only for AMT, not the RNA-probe route or its PCR step. The block is catalogue-supported but its implementation-specific primary confirmation remains open under u2.

The catalogue architecture and all retained routes are supported at the depicted/prose level, and the focal full text was checked against the retained operations. Scientific acceptance remains pending because the supplied primary implementation uses ssDNA probes, whereas this graph requires biotinylated RNA probes and their post-RT removal.
